summary: Iteration 4 — Auto-Coach Per-Agent Weekly Email feature tested end-to-end. Backend: 9/9 relevant pytest tests pass (1 skipped because existing agents were present). Frontend: AgentsPanel renders in Analytics tab, add/preview/send-all/delete flows all work, Resend sandbox failures surface correctly in the 'failed' list (endpoint returns 200, does NOT 500). Pre-existing flows (digest preview, leaderboard, send-slack 400) still work.

issues: Badge still reads 'Email coming soon' in the Slack digest panel even though RESEND_API_KEY is now configured. The Email sending functionality is implemented in the separate AgentsPanel below, but the old DigestPanel's 'Email coming soon' chip becomes confusing/misleading — consider removing that chip or renaming it to 'Per-agent emails below ↓'.

Accessibility warning in console: 'Missing Description or aria-describedby={undefined} for {DialogContent}'. Add a DialogDescription (or aria-describedby) to the preview Dialog in AgentsPanel.jsx to satisfy Radix UI a11y.

verified_flows: POST /api/agents creates agent {name,email}; duplicate name => 409; response has no _id
GET /api/agents lists agents sorted by created_at desc, no _id leak
DELETE /api/agents/{id} removes agent and returns {deleted:true}; repeat delete => 404

POST /api/digest/send-agent-emails?days=7 => 200 with {sent:[],failed:[{agent,email,error:'You can only send testing emails to your own email address...'}],total_agents:2} — Resend 403 properly caught, no 500

Frontend: AgentsPanel renders with agents-panel + agents-table; agent-add-btn creates row; agent-preview-{id} opens dialog with email HTML in agent-email-preview (377-char 'No calls evaluated' template for new agent); email-all-agents-btn triggers send endpoint (console log 'Email failures: [Object, Object]' seen -> toast.warning path hit); agent-delete-{id} removes row; agent-period-14/30 togglable
Existing flows: /api/analytics/leaderboard OK, /api/digest/preview?days=7 returns plain_text, /api/digest/send-slack returns 400 (unconfigured, intentional)
action_items: OPTIONAL (design): Remove or rename the 'Email coming soon' chip in DigestPanel since per-agent email IS now configured via the AgentsPanel below.
OPTIONAL (a11y): Add <DialogDescription> inside the preview Dialog in AgentsPanel.jsx (line ~277) to silence 'Missing Description or aria-describedby' Radix warning.
CLEANUP: A pre-seeded 'Sarah Khan / sarah@test.com' agent row is present in Mongo from earlier development. Harmless but users may want to delete it via the UI trash icon.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py:853 _send_email_resend correctly wraps the blocking resend SDK via asyncio.to_thread — good.
server.py:879-884 try/except around _send_email_resend per-agent prevents one bad email from taking down the whole batch — correct pattern.
server.py:682-726 agent CRUD uses {'_id':0} projection in list_agents + model response — no ObjectId leak, verified.
server.py:689 AgentBase uses EmailStr from pydantic — requires email-validator package. Confirmed installed (pytest passed POST /api/agents with valid email).
server.py:868 'if not agents' raises 400 before hitting Resend — matches spec.
AgentsPanel.jsx:93-120 handleSendAll differentiates toast.warning (partial failure) vs toast.success — UX is good.
AgentsPanel.jsx 'Email coming soon' is actually in DigestPanel.jsx (different file) — should be updated separately.
Minor: preview dialog lacks DialogDescription (a11y warning), agent-email-preview uses dangerouslySetInnerHTML (acceptable since HTML comes from our own backend template, but worth noting).

success_rate.frontend: 100% (add, preview, send-all, delete, period toggle all verified)

seed_data_creation: Test agents created with 'TEST_' prefix are auto-cleaned by pytest fixture. One E2E_Agent_68187 was created via UI and then deleted. Pre-existing 'Sarah Khan / sarah@test.com' remains from earlier dev.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Auto-Coach agent email feature is fully functional. Backend pytest regression lives at /app/backend/tests/test_agent_emails.py (run: pytest /app/backend/tests/ -v). Resend is in sandbox mode — unverified recipients return error 'You can only send testing emails to your own email address (rajenterprises827014@gmail.com)' which the endpoint catches and returns in failed[]. Two minor design nits only (see design_issues). No functional blockers.
